Maya: Quick sync — capstone hands-on lab for new SIs launches next Wed. Need a short preflight and cert tune. Who can join Fri for preflight?
Jordan: I can do Fri. Also can we get a staging gateway image & a higher mem flavor for the quantized run?
Samir: I'll own the certification rubric and tasks. Need to confirm pass criteria (is 3 retries ok?).
Elena: Partner ops — on HW vouchers & marketplace copy. How many seats per cohort? need lead time for vouchers and partner comms.
Maya: Seats = 12 per cohort. Marketplace copy draft here: https://drive.redwood/example-capstone-copy. Also we need an HW partner runbook (setup + troubleshooting). cc Ruth to coordinate shipping.
Ruth: Noted. Inventory check scheduled today. Will share serial list and shipping ETA by Tue EOD.
onboard-bot: Draft lab environment provisioned: https://sandbox.redwood.test/si-capstone-1767 — creds expire in 7 days.
Jordan: Nice. Small ask: bump memory to 24GB for the quantized models in that sandbox (currently 16GB). Will help with headroom during latency tests.
Samir: For the cert tuning — propose 4 tasks: deploy pipeline, latency tuning, rollback & fault injection, observability trace analysis. Pass = complete all tasks within 3 retries or documented remediation.
Maya: Sounds reasonable. Samir, can you post task templates and a sample scoring sheet? add a prompt-eval smoke check too.
Samir: Posted templates here: https://drive.redwood/si-capstone-templates and paste snippet: 
```
Task 2: Latency tuning
- baseline: p50 < 150ms
- knobs: batching, kv-cache, quant profile
- validation: run `perf-suite --profile si-capstone`
```
Elena: Marketplace partner asked for joint announcement timing. They prefer a 2-week embargo after cohort start to gather case studies. legal signoff required.
Ruth: 2-week embargo ok from ops side. I'll ping legal and track approvals.
Jordan: Fri preflight works — 10:00am PT. I'll pair with Samir for a cert dry run and validate the perf-suite results.
Maya: Great. Can @marketplace-bot schedule the announcement draft review for Mon so product/comms can iterate?
marketplace-bot: Scheduled: Announcement draft review on Mon 09:00 PT — doc: https://drive.redwood/marketplace-draft. Reminder set for reviewers.
Samir: Will finalize rubric by EOD Tue and add scoring matrix. :thumbsup:
Elena: I'll set a short partner briefing this week to align on runbook and embargo. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Action items recap — Jordan/Samir: preflight + dry run Fri 10am PT; Samir: finalize exam rubric; Ruth: HW dispatch plan + legal ping; Elena: marketplace copy & partner briefing; Maya: run the canary cohort and monitor. Thanks all :rocket:
